# Sessions

![Sessions function icon](../../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/connectivity.web_services.application_web_server.sessions.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../../index.md) · [All functions](../../../index.md)

Author creation, lookup, update and deletion of Web Service sessions and their named values.

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Create Session.vi](../application/sessions/create.md) | Creates an HTTP session for the current HTTP request. |
| [Check If Session Exists.vi](../application/sessions/exists.md) | Checks whether the current HTTP request has an associated HTTP session. |
| [Get Session ID Cookie.vi](../application/sessions/get_id_cookie.md) | Reads the cookie identifying the HTTP session for this client. |
| [Destroy Session.vi](../application/sessions/destroy.md) | Destroys the HTTP session associated with the current request. |
| [Read Session Variable.vi](../application/sessions/read_variable.md) | Reads the string value of a named HTTP session variable. |
| [Read All Session Variables.vi](../application/sessions/read_all_variables.md) | Reads HTTP session variables as parallel key and value arrays. |
| [Write Session Variable.vi](../application/sessions/write_variable.md) | Creates or replaces typed session variables and returns their previous string values. |
| [Delete Session Variable.vi](../application/sessions/delete_variable.md) | Deletes the named variable from the current HTTP session. |
